request.project_task: Build an online symptom triage and appointment routing service.
request.project_goal: Route non-emergency requests while identifying cases needing urgent help.
request.project_description: A patient answers questions; the service gives a routing recommendation and schedules eligible requests.

functional_requirements.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

atoms.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

functional_requirements.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

atoms.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

functional_requirements.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

atoms.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

functional_requirements.text: The patient books an offered appointment.

functional_requirements.text: A clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

Sensitive answers must be accessible only to the patient and assigned clinician.

actors.description: A person seeking non-emergency symptom triage and appointment routing.

actors.name: Clinician
actors.description: A healthcare professional who reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

use_cases.name: Complete symptom triage and route care
use_cases.goal: Allow a patient to select a symptom category, answer questions, receive an emergency warning or care route recommendation, and book an appointment if eligible.
use_cases.trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.

preconditions.text: The patient has access to the triage service.

success_postconditions.text: The patient has received a care route recommendation or emergency warning.
If eligible, an appointment is booked.

failure_postconditions.text: The triage session is incomplete or no recommendation is provided.

steps.action: System evaluates answers for configured red flags.
System recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
System displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

user_stories.capability: select a symptom category and answer questions

system_stories.system_action: Evaluate answers for configured red flags and display emergency warning if present.
Recommend a care route for non-emergency answers.

missing_information.description: The red-flag rule set is not provided.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Complete symptom triage and route care
Goal: Allow a patient to select a symptom category, answer questions, receive an emergency warning or care route recommendation, and book an appointment if eligible.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The patient has access to the triage service.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Patient selects a symptom category.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Patient answers category-specific questions.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System evaluates answers for configured red flags.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] System recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
  5. [STEP-UC001-005] Patient books an offered appointment.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-ALT-001: Emergency warning displayed
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005

use_cases.goal: Allow a clinician to review submitted answers before the appointment.

success_postconditions.text: Clinician has reviewed the submitted answers.

failure_postconditions.text: Clinician cannot access or review the answers.

steps.action: Clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

user_stories.capability: review submitted answers before the appointment

system_stories.system_action: Provide submitted answers to the assigned clinician.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Review submitted answers
Goal: Allow a clinician to review submitted answers before the appointment.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Clinician accesses the review interface.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: The patient has submitted answers.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Clinician accesses the review interface.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] Clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.
Source FRs: FR-006

use_cases.goal: Allow a patient to correct answers before clinician review.

preconditions.text: The patient has submitted answers and clinician review has not occurred.

steps.action: Patient chooses to correct answers before clinician review.

system_stories.system_action: Allow patient to modify answers before clinician review.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Correct answers before clinician review
Goal: Allow a patient to correct answers before clinician review.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient chooses to correct answers.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: The patient has submitted answers and clinician review has not occurred.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Patient chooses to correct answers before clinician review.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Patient corrects answers.
Source FRs: FR-007
